title: Add a morphology-to-per-bone influence-radius bridge for the implicit welded-surface weighting
description:
## Summary
CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer.Bind (TSK-0132) and ImplicitSurfaceWeightAuthoring.BuildSegmentInfluences (TSK-0131) accept an optional radiiByBoneIndex and fall back to a flat ImplicitSurfaceWeightAuthoring.DefaultInfluenceRadius=0.5 when none is supplied. No code currently derives real per-bone influence radii from the resolved morphology (Body sample radius / limb metaball thickness at each segment). Weights on real generated creatures therefore risk using a constant 0.5 influence shell instead of thickness-aware radii, which understates/overstates joint blending on actual geometry.

## User Mandate
- Keep the pure authoring core contract from TSK-0131 unchanged.
- Do not change the DNA model or add a second derivation path.
- Only touch runtime animation/skinning binding and the relevant tests.
- This is a bridge at the adapter/runtime boundary.
- The flat DefaultInfluenceRadius=0.5 fallback remains the deterministic gap for missing morphology values.

## Scope
- Add a pure, headless bridge that derives one influence radius per bone index from the resolved DNA morphology the welded surface was built from (Body sample radius at the nearest spine segment; limb metaball/segment thickness for limb segment bones), in SkeletonSnapshot.Capture bone-index order.
- Consume it in the TSK-0132 adapter Bind path so real creatures get thickness-derived radii instead of the 0.5 default.
- Keep the bridge build-time pure data (no per-frame recompute); runtime presenter supplies/consumes it; do not guess a radius inside the pure authoring core (preserve TSK-0131 contract).
- Do not alter the DNA model or add a second derivation path.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A generated Body surface and a thin limb get per-bone radii consistent with their authored morphology (not the 0.5 default) in a focused test.
- Rest-pose and known-pose LBS/SMR parity still hold with the derived radii.
- Falls back deterministically where morphology lacks a radius for a bone.

## Validation
- `dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Runtime.csproj --no-restore` -> exit 0
- `dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore` -> exit 0
- `dotnet test ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore --filter "MorphologyInfluenceRadii_BodyAndThinLimb_UseResolvedMorphology_NotDefaultHalf" --logger "console;verbosity=minimal"` -> exit 0
- `git diff --check` -> exit 0
